name: berberis vulgaris root bark + collinsonia canadensis root + hamamelis virginiana root bark/stem bark + sodium borate
purpose: Purpose Temporary relief from vaginal itching, burning and irritation
uses: Uses Uses For the temporary relief of symptoms associated with vagianl yeast infection, including: itching burning irritation
otcwarn: Do not use if you have never had a vaginal yeast infection diagnosed by a doctor Ask a doctor before use if you have Vaginal itching and discomfort for the first time Lower abdominal, back or shoulder pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, or foul-smelling vaginal discharge. You may have a serious condition. Vaginal yeast infections often (such as once a month or 3 in 6 months). You could be pregnant or have a serious underlying medical cause for you symptoms, including diabetes or a weakened immune system. Been exposed to the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) that causes AIDS You have an STD (sexually transmitted disease) or PID (Pelvic inflammatory disease) You have frequent and painful urination Stop use and ask a doctor if: Symptoms last more than 7 days You get a rash or hives, abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, or foul-smelling vagina.
